title: Why “kwartaalcijfers nvidia” is trending in BE: 500+ searches, the facts (November 18, 2026)
description: “kwartaalcijfers nvidia” is trending in BE with 500+ searches reported by Google. The verified coverage behind the spike, from De Standaard and 2 more.

sections.heading: What is trending: “kwartaalcijfers nvidia”
paragraphs: “kwartaalcijfers nvidia” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for BE (snapshot taken 2026-11-18T13:58:08+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 500 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from De Standaard, De Tijd, HLN. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “Ondanks verdubbeling omzet is Nvidia “niet van plan” Jensen Huang weer aan te stellen als CEO” — HLN
“Er mochten wel enkele honderden miljarden in rook opgaan” — De Standaard
“Geen terugkeer voor Jensen Huang, wel recordcijfers: interim-topvrouw stelt Nvidia-belegger gerust” — De Tijd

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Wed, 18 Nov 2026 04:10:00 -0800. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-11-18T13:58:08+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-11-18T13:58:40+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
